aarti.pad1: Victory to you, Kūṣmāṇḍā, giver of happiness to the world; have mercy on me, great queen. You are Piṅgalā, the wondrous Jvālāmukhī, Mother Śākambharī, simple and innocent. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: You have lakhs of names, each one wondrous; many of your devotees are lost in love of you. Your dwelling is on Mount Bhīmā; accept this salutation of mine. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: You hear everyone, Jagadambā; you bring happiness, Mother Ambā. I thirst for the sight of you; fulfil my hope. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: The Mother has deep tenderness in her heart; why would she not hear our plea? I have made my camp at your door; Mother, remove my trouble. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Bring my tasks to completion; fill my storehouses. Your servant meditates on you alone; your devotee bows his head at your door. ॥5॥
